task_labels.exclusion_policy: Source labels listed here are dropped before training. They are never folded into Negative or any other class of the three-class task; Toxic rows stay out of the corpus and only their row counts are recorded for auditing.

source_roles.rationale: NEU-ESC declares an Apache-2.0 license in the dataset metadata published by its authors, so it can carry the three-class training artifact. UIT-VSFC has no license file and stays limited to offline research/evaluation, so it is used as the in-domain benchmark instead of being the only training source.
source_roles.combined_corpus_rule: Every sample keeps a DatasetSource value. Metrics are always reported per source, and the three-class task never mixes an unlicensed source into a distributable artifact.

uit_vsfc.name: UIT-VSFC v1.0
uit_vsfc.access_requirement: Public Google Drive folder; no gating.
uit_vsfc.citation: Kiet Van Nguyen, Vu Duc Nguyen, Phu Xuan-Vinh Nguyen, Tham Thi-Hong Truong, Ngan Luu-Thuy Nguyen. UIT-VSFC: Vietnamese Students' Feedback Corpus for Sentiment Analysis. KSE 2018.

neu_esc.name: NEU-ESC
neu_esc.license_source: Machine-readable `license: apache-2.0` in the YAML frontmatter of the dataset card published by the dataset authors, which is the origin channel this dataset is released through.

license_evidence.card_license_section_quote: This dataset is released under an open-source license for research and educational purposes. Please ensure proper citation when using it in your work.
license_evidence.note: The dataset card is public even though the CSV files are gated, so this evidence can be verified before requesting access.

neu_esc.license_note: Both statements live in the same card, but they are not equivalent: the frontmatter tag is `apache-2.0` while the body only says 'an open-source license for research and educational purposes'. The tag is recorded here, but the body wording suggests a narrower scope. Confirm with the dataset owners before derived artifacts are distributed outside the project team.
neu_esc.access_requirement: Gated dataset (`gated: auto`). File names are public but content requires a Hugging Face account that accepted the dataset conditions plus an access token passed as HF_TOKEN.
neu_esc.citation: Nguyen Quang Hung, Mai Phan Quoc Hung, Nguyen Thi Hong Hanh, Duong Phuong Giang. NEU-ESC: NEU Dataset for Educational Sentiment Analysis and Topic Classification. 2024.
